panel.title: Query duration
panel.sql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS time,
  quantile(0.5)(query_duration_ms) AS p50,
  quantile(0.95)(query_duration_ms) AS p95,
  quantile(0.99)(query_duration_ms) AS p99
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
